About the bakery

A Southland local, through and through

Winton Bakery is the town’s coffee shop and bakery — bread, cakes, pastries and hot cabinet food, baked on the premises at 188 Great North Road.

Locals drive in for the cream buns, and travellers stop on their way through Southland. Come early — the hot food goes fast around lunchtime.

“World Famous in Winton”

— painted on the bakery wall, and the town agrees
